name: Miranda Wei
one_sentence_summary: Miranda Wei is an incoming EPFL Tenure-Track Assistant Professor (fall 2026) whose research sits at the intersection of security & privacy, HCI, and feminist STS, with a focus on online abuse, digital safety threats, and sociotechnically-informed approaches to harm reduction.
matrix_summary: Miranda Wei is joining EPFL IC as a new Tenure-Track Assistant Professor in fall 2026, bringing expertise in human-centred security & privacy and online abuse research. She is actively recruiting PhD students (EDIC deadline December 1, 2026) and recently won the 2025 William Chan Memorial Dissertation Award.
